# Proprietary files: iBall Slide Skye 03

Two system-side libraries from the stock ROM that stock vendor binaries
link against:

- `proprietary/lib/libefuse.so`
- `proprietary/lib/librpmbclient.so`

Source build: `iBall/Slide_Skye_03/Slide_Skye_03:8.1.0/OPM2.171019.012/32419:user/release-keys`.
These files are proprietary to their owners (iBall / Unisoc) and are
provided only for building the LineageOS port for this device.
